study: Independent confirmation of development-selected compact JEPA
source_data_scope: Existing training/validation/development data and all twelve fits have already been observed. This registration precedes only the NEW confirmation. Original semantic-study rejection and its reserved holdouts remain untouched.
selection_rule: Among the two new JEPA families, minimize equal-cost mean command-loss ratio to RadioMap on all prior development sites and all three training members; exact rational comparison, lexicographic tie-break. No member/checkpoint/threshold retuning.
conditions: Even site stationary, odd site hidden drift; same procedural CAD, no physical warehouse claim.
comparators: Three separately evaluated chosen JEPA members, three matched supervised members, strong RadioMap, and original frozen three-member fleet JEPA ensemble. No new fitting.
controller: Reuse fixed shared cost-specific controls: OutageBudgetGate+reactive_rescue at0.03s, OutageUtility30+rescue at4s. Same semantics as the source study, no new tuning.
timing: Reuse source-study sealed profiles without retiming. All new neural members share the same conservative envelope; numerical and frozen-original comparators retain their recorded profiles. Startup separate; any actual overrun vetoes success.
primary: All six candidate/reference/cost comparisons use whole-site bootstrap after averaging paired training members, upper1-.05/6<0 under observed AND conservative endpoint counters. Report every comparison, including negative/null. No claim of winning all references unless all pass.

claim_definitions.numerical_benefit: Per cost, superiority plus engineering margins versus RadioMap.
claim_definitions.original_jepa_improvement: Per cost, superiority plus engineering margins versus original frozen JEPA; this is a package comparison with different training/data/inference, not an isolated objective effect.
claim_definitions.objective_advantage: Per cost, superiority plus engineering margins versus matched supervised. A win does not isolate EMA necessity from auxiliary future-target supervision.
claim_definitions.broad_best_claim: Requires all references at both costs; never infer from a subset.

engineering: Per reference/cost candidate worst-decile with pending misses <=refobserved+1/1200; maxsilence<=ref+.05s; originalvideo>=ref-.01; bulk>=.99ref. Report zero-margin results too. These are empirical research thresholds, not production qualification.
endpoint: Candidate unresolved controls are misses, reference unresolved controls are successes. Preserve packet generation/queues.
replays: First new site: RadioMap, original frozen JEPA, selected member0 and supervised member0 at each cost; eight exact result/forecast/telemetry/action replays.
activation: Offline only, no physical commands, default swap, production/SOTA/novelty/universal claim. Matched supervised comparisons remain visible regardless outcome.
